description: Ministry of Industrial Export & Investment Promotion - The Project to set up the CIFC at Prot City premises in Colombo
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Strategic Development Projects Act, No. 14 of 2008 and outlines specific tax exemptions and regulatory concessions (including corporate income tax, dividend tax, withholding tax, VAT, and customs duty exemptions) for a designated development project. It constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement established under existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter rather than a government personnel/structure announcement or other specialized category.
